derivation: Generated from the evidence register. Authorship certainty and public display eligibility are separate fields and are listed separately below. This file is generated; edit the evidence register and regenerate.
contract_note: PUBLIC DISPLAY DOES NOT RESOLVE AUTHORSHIP. A song appearing in displayable_song_ids is not thereby attributed to Kalaignar. Only established_kalaignar_song_ids may carry a positive Kalaignar-authorship claim. Songs in unresolved_authorship_song_ids are neither claimed as Kalaignar's nor denied to him.
inclusion_rule: Two independent determinations. AUTHORSHIP: the decision is established-kalaignar if and only if at least one evidence item supports Kalaignar at evidence level A, B or C and no material conflict is declared; level D never qualifies, whichever witness it comes from, and unresolved and insufficient-evidence are never converted into “not Kalaignar”. PUBLIC DISPLAY: every numbered lyric of the controlling source is displayable, and a displayed song whose authorship is not established carries an authorship-uncertainty notice instead of an authorship claim. Display eligibility is never evidence of authorship.

public_authorship_notices.notice_ta: ஆசிரியர் குறிப்பு: 2024 தொகுப்பில் ‘அம்மையப்பன்’ திரைப்படத்தின் பாடல்கள் முழுமையாக இடம்பெற்றுள்ளன. அவற்றில் எவை கலைஞர் எழுதியவை என்பதை உறுதிப்படுத்த முடியவில்லை என்று தொகுப்பாசிரியர் குறிப்பிட்டுள்ளார். பாடல் 012-க்கு தனித்த ஆதாரம் கிடைத்துள்ளது; பாடல்கள் 013–018-க்கு தனிப்பட்ட பாடலாசிரியர் ஆதாரம் இதுவரை கிடைக்கவில்லை.
public_authorship_notices.notice_en: Authorship note: The 2024 compilation includes all the songs from Ammayappan and states that the compiler could not confirm which individual songs were written by Kalaignar. Separate evidence establishes song 012; no song-specific authorship evidence has been found for songs 013–018.
public_authorship_notices.basis: The 2024 compiler explicitly states his inability to confirm which அம்மையப்பன் songs Kalaignar wrote (PDF 43), printing one collective four-writer credit for the whole film. Song 012 is separately established from the 1989 witness's song-specific editorial note; songs 013-018 have no song-specific authorship evidence in either witness.
public_authorship_notices.downstream_contract: A Reading Room surface that displays any song in this group must present this notice with it, and must not present a Kalaignar-authorship claim for it. This is source metadata only; no page is built here.
